facts.text: All undergraduate students admitted to the Dozoretz National Institute for Mathematics and Applied Sciences (DNIMAS) receive a comprehensive four-year scholarship and grant package covering tuition, fees, room, board, and books.

sources.title: Special Academic Programs - Catalog - Norfolk State University
sources.quote: The DNIMAS program is unique. All of its students are supported by full, four-year scholarship/grant aid. It represents a major commitment by Norfolk State University to provide the best possible education in the sciences
